patch.value: Enhance pm-graph impact to use canonical registry-aware pm graph engine with graceful fallback and diagram rendering

Delegate pm pm-graph impact to the canonical pm graph impact engine (registry-aware, honors custom relationship kinds) with graceful fallback to the existing reverseReachable path on older pm-cli. Add --direction/--depth/--limit/--format flags, build an impact subgraph projector for --format mermaid|dot|graphml diagrams, and keep the back-compat result shape.

author: pi-agent
message: Started: probing pm graph impact contract, adding pmGraphAvailable/runPmGraph helpers, direction mapping, impact subgraph projector, and enhancing the impact command.

patch.value: pm pm-graph impact now delegates to the canonical registry-aware pm graph engine (rich affected rows + cost), preserves the back-compat shape, supports --direction/--depth/--limit/--format, renders mermaid/dot/graphml diagrams, and falls back to reverseReachable on older pm-cli. devDependency bumped to ^2026.7.23; peer floor unchanged.
Implemented canonical pm graph impact engine delegation with graceful fallback, direction mapping, impact subgraph projectors, and diagram rendering
